events.name: San Jose Sharks at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Alexander Wennberg scored with 2:49 left in overtime, and the San Jose Sharks came back from a two-goal deficit to beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 3-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wennberg's goal in OT helps Sharks rally from 2-goal deficit, beat Maple Leafs 3-2

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Nick Paul, Darren Raddysh and Pontus Holmberg each scored in the opening eight minutes to chase Jacob Markstrom, and the injury-depleted Tampa Bay Lightning defeated the New Jersey Devils 8-4 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lightning chase Jacob Markstrom on the way to routing the Devils 8-4

events.name: Anaheim Ducks at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Anders Lee scored twice and had two assists, and David Rittich made 31 saves as the New York Islanders beat the Anaheim Ducks 5-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anders Lee scores twice as Islanders beat Ducks 5-2

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Philadelphia Flyers

headlines.description: — Mark Stone scored his second goal of the game 2:47 into overtime to give the Vegas Golden Knights a 3-2 victory over the Philadelphia Flyers on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stone scores his 2nd goal of the game in OT to lift the Golden Knights over the Flyers 3-2

headlines.description: — Brandon Bussi stopped all three shots in a shootout to lift the Carolina Hurricanes to a 3-2 victory over the Washington Capitals on Thursday night in a matchup of the top two teams in the Eastern Conference standings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hurricanes top Capitals 3-2 in SO in a matchup of the top teams in the Eastern Conference standings

events.name: Ottawa Senators at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Tim Stützle scored twice, and the Ottawa Senators used a four-goal first period to beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 6–3 on Thursday night, snapping a three-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stützle scores 2 as Senators use 4-goal 1st period to beat Blue Jackets 6–3

headlines.description: — Jacob Fowler made 33 saves in his NHL debut and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 4-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fowler makes 33 saves in NHL debut as Canadiens beat Penguins 4-2

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Nashville Predators

headlines.description: — Steven Stamkos scored four goals and the Nashville Predators beat the St. Louis Blues 7-2 on Thursday night for their fourth win in five games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stamkos scores 4 goals as Predators beat Blues 7-2 for 4th win in 5 games

headlines.description: — Marcus Johansson scored twice, Matt Boldy had a goal and two assists, and the Minnesota Wild beat Dallas 5-2 on Thursday night, ending the Stars' 11-game point streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Johansson scores 2, Boldy has goal and assist in Wild's 5-2 win to snap Stars' 11-game point streak

headlines.description: — David Pastrnak had two goals and two assists, leading the Boston Bruins to a 6-3 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pastrnak nets 4 points as the Bruins beat the Jets 6-3

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Edmonton Oilers

headlines.description: — Zach Hyman scored three goals and Connor McDavid had four assists as the Edmonton Oilers beat the Detroit Red Wings 4-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hyman has 3 goals, McDavid gets 4 assists as Oilers beat Red Wings 4-1

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon was one of six Colorado players to score and the Avalanche cruised to a 6-2 win over the Florida Panthers on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nathan MacKinnon leads a balanced scoring attack as Avalanche cruise to 6-2 win over Panthers

headlines.description: — Rasmus Dahlin and Tage Thompson each had a goal and an assist, and the Buffalo Sabres beat the struggling Vancouver Canucks 3-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dahlin, Thompson each have goal and assist as Sabres beat Canucks 3-2
